htmlCases.semantics: ArkWeb holder is a synthetic Document boundary for Jsoup child pseudo evaluation
top-level fragment nodes cannot satisfy nth-child under the Jsoup Document
a single top-level fragment node is still not a child of Jsoup Document
of-type pseudos also fail closed under Jsoup Document
real element parents retain standard child semantics
real element parents retain same-tag type indexing
:has relative selectors use the actual element root, not the synthetic holder
:not observes the Jsoup Document boundary of its nested selector
a standard pseudo on the first compound must be evaluated on its ancestor, not the terminal link
a pseudo in a later compound remains native because its parent is a real element

representativeRules: body > table:nth-child(4) > tbody > tr > td > span > a
